Today is September 1st, and Apple has officially handed over the CEO role from Tim Cook to John Ternus, marking the beginning of a new era under Ternus's leadership.

You can see this personnel change on Apple's newly updated leadership page, where Ternus has been given the CEO title, while Cook has moved to a board position as the new Executive Chairman.

It is widely expected that Ternus's ascension to the top will signal a shift in the company's strategy. Compared to Cook's operational management strengths, Ternus is likely to place greater emphasis on a product-driven vision. However, these changes will take time to unfold. His first public appearance will be at the autumn launch event on September 9th, where he will introduce the all-new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra product lines.

Previously, board members were listed by name only on the leadership webpage. Following Cook's addition to the board, Apple has also expanded this section to include individual photos of each member.

The board members include Tim Cook, Arthur Levinson, Wanda Austin, Alex Gorsky, Andrea Jung, Monica Lozano, Ron Sugar, Sue Wagner, along with John Ternus (serving as CEO and Director concurrently).
